regime_context: Detector shows a broad, non-directional rotation (73% of themes eligible, absorption 0.32) with Memory/HBM & Storage as a clean rank-1 leader and Silver Miners/Gold Miners as the challengers. Gate discipline did help on this market's history (gate_helps true), but rank-IC is ~0 so momentum is only a focus lens; the one validated edge is drawdown control, not return forecasting.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Silver Miners (SIL) closes the rank gap to Memory/HBM & Storage by retaking breadth 1.0 AND holding it for 5 consecutive sessions while the leader's breadth stays at 0.0 — that would retire the watch and mark a confirmed leadership handoff.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners (GDX) ranks 3 with a 'trend' hurst tag, full breadth (1.0), highest durability bar among eligible leaders (0.84), and no crowding (z 0.55). The trend-gate eligibility plus breadth and cohesion support a durable leadership read, not a momentum call. This is a stay-with-trend lean, sized by the allocator, and is the most structurally coherent of the top themes.
theses.dissent: Gold miners are rate/policy sensitive; if the dominant macro narrative (AI-tech, 38 of 63 recent headlines) keeps capital rotating into semiconductor-adjacent themes, miners may stall despite technical cohesion.

falsifier.text: GDX breaks below its 50-day moving average and stays there for 10 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners (SIL) ranks 2 with full breadth (1.0), high durability (0.79), and uncrowded conditions (z 0.69). It is the rotation challenger, and the trend-gate leg (already eligible) plus cohesion argues for staying overweight while leadership confirms — not a momentum chase, but a durability read.
theses.dissent: Silver has high beta to industrial demand; if AI-infrastructure capex cools and drags industrial metals sentiment, SIL could hand back its leadership quickly.

falsifier.text: SIL underperforms GDX by 5% over any 10-trading-day stretch before the check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity (CIBR) ranks 6 but shows crowding_z 1.57 (flagged crowded) despite a decent durability bar (0.78) and 'trend' hurst tag. The crowding flag is a size-down caution, and given the validated edge is drawdown control (not returns), an avoid lean keeps the book away from an extended, attention-heavy theme with no uncrowded entry cushion.
evidence: rank 6 despite crowding — attention may be peaking
theses.dissent: Cybersecurity has secular demand drivers and a high durability bar; crowding flags here have no basket-level forward edge, so avoiding could miss continued grind higher.

falsifier.text: CIBR pulls back less than 3% from current level while the S&P 500 makes a new high before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
